+        extra keys (origin, destination, price, cabin) are ignored.

+        account holder or a saved passenger on the profile, their dob is filled in
+      - Each payment object is {"payment_id": ..., "amount": ...}. If the amounts
+        you pass do not add up to the exact total price, and exactly one payment
+        method is used, the amount is corrected automatically; if a credit card is
+        among several methods, the leftover is put on the credit card.
